Interface JobsAPI

public interface JobsAPI
Tempest Jobs for other plugins: which jobs there are, which a player holds, and their levels. Add, never change; raise API_VERSION when adding. Get it with get(): null while Jobs is not running. 
JobsAPI jobs = JobsAPI.get();
if (jobs != null && jobs.holds(uuid, "miner") && jobs.level(uuid, "miner") >= 10) { ... }
Money a job pays goes through Core's economy ("Job: Miner"); Core's PlayerActions tells of it as jobs_paid (the amount) and of every job level gained as jobs_level (the new level).
